card.vhead: Top 3 · for my setup and for a fresh setup

records.title: Eight ADEs tested: my top three

recommendationLabels.text: 01PASEOQualified. Best overall on the recorded tests, including a real OpenRouter request. The qualified terminal route uses a saved login-shell profile; the default remains non-login.

02SHEPRDProvisional. Startup and input passed with a pre-started herdr-core 0.1.18 and saved login-shell setting; native chat and child collection passed too. Open source with strong file configuration; authenticated API-key inference remains unverified.

03AGENTASTICProvisional. Default startup forwarding and actual native key editing passed. Good defaults and free core workflow; closed source with no Linux desktop. Authenticated API-key inference remains unverified.
